Harmonized financial measures for 990 and 990-EZ filers

Source: R/core.R
merger_measures.Rd

Adds plain-named measures used by the attribute tables and the fiscal panel. Revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, net assets, grants, and contributions are available for both 990 and 990-EZ filers. The functional-expense breakdown (overhead), executive compensation, employees, and debt detail come from the full Form 990 only and are NA for 990-EZ filers.

Usage

merger_measures(x)

Arguments

x

An organization-year table (from org_years()).

Value

x with measure columns added: REVENUE, EXPENSES, SURPLUS, ASSETS, ASSETS_BOY, LIABILITIES, NET_ASSETS, DEBT, CONTRIBUTIONS, PROGRAM_REVENUE, NONCASH_CONTRIB, GRANTS, STAFF_EXP, EXEC_COMP, PROGRAM_EXP, MGMT_EXP, FUNDR_EXP, OVERHEAD_RATIO, EMPLOYEES, and EZ (990-EZ return).
